trap.label: too × either
trap.wrong: I did not share it, and my friends did not too.
trap.right: I did not share it, and my friends did not either.
trap.why: Em português “também não” traduz-se com “também”, o que leva a too. Em inglês, too vem em frases afirmativas; either, em negativas.

mcq.q: “I didn’t share it, and she didn’t ___.”
Same subject: “I shared it and ___ it.”

fix.wrong: I didn’t check, and she didn’t too.
fix.right: I didn’t check, and she didn’t either.

fix.wrong: I shared it and I regretted it twice.
fix.right: I shared it and regretted it twice.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com too: “Friends shared it. Others shared it.” → “Friends did; others did ___.”
Reescreva com either: “I didn’t read it. She didn’t read it.” (…, and she didn’t …)
rewrite.answer: I didn’t read it, and she didn’t either.

rewrite.prompt: Aplique elipse de sujeito: “I shared it and I regretted it.”
rewrite.answer: I shared it and regretted it.
